title: Polynomiality of Plancherel averages of symmetric functions of squared hook lengths
difficulty_reason: After reusing the already-adopted ex88 coefficient-functional lemmas only as support, this target still carries a new square-hook alphabet construction A_lambda=C_lambda+D_n-B_lambda. Its essential step is recognising that h_c(B_lambda) is symmetric in the shifted parts rho_i=lambda_i+n-i because (rho_i-rho_j)^2 is symmetric under interchange, while the unsquared expression is not. This permits the separately symmetric Theorem3.3 polynomiality theorem to close the Plancherel sum after factoring the D_n terms. Standard lambda-ring expansions and the routine power sums of Lemma4.2 are prerequisites/bookkeeping; the choice of alphabet and reduction supply the nonroutine residual. The level reuses the prior concrete H2 judgment, not the theorem name or author attribution.
